text.tspan: A tech enthusiast and systems-focused IT specialist from Belarus.
My journey started in Full-stack software engineering, where I built and maintained
production systems across the entire lifecycle—from polishing interactive Frontend UIs to
architecting backend services and CLI tools in Go. This gave me deep visibility into how
applications behave from the inside out and how software integrates with modern
However, complex systems are only as good as the networks that connect them. Today, my
primary focus has shifted toward Systems and Network Administration. I'm channeling my
• Linux Networking Stack & Kernel-level packet flow
• L2/L3 Diagnostics, deep troubleshooting, and traffic analysis
I love taking apart messy technical issues, understanding exactly how packets travel
under the hood, and keeping infrastructure rock-solid. Let's connect!
